description: Closes an open user global library by name (from tia_global_libraries; exact name first, then ignoring case; unsaved changes are not saved — call tia_global_library_save first) and returns its name as {closed}. Serves after app 1.6.3 refuse a name that picks no single open USER library, nothing closed: an unknown or already-closed name is 404 kind:"not_found"; a system or corporate library (read-only), or a name several user libraries match only ignoring case, is 409 kind:"conflict"; details.userLibraries / systemLibraries / corporateLibraries list the open libraries (up to 1.6.3: 200 {closed:<name>} even when nothing was closed — confirm the name with tia_global_libraries first). A library open read-only can be closed. Maps to POST /globallibraries/close {name}. Class M-off.
